max_price.description: Upper price bound in GBP, applied at source

networks.description: Marketplaces to search. Default: both. Send only when choosing - an empty array is rejected as "no valid networks" (per the first-party SDK).

min_price.description: Lower price bound in GBP. Sent by the first-party JavaScript and Python SDKs; not in the docs field table.

currency.description: Sent by the first-party SDKs (always GBP); not in the docs field table.

Network.description: Marketplace identifier. ebay_uk is live; amazon_uk is rolling out and returns a search_link result.
